steps.u: Add property-based tests for our money splitting function: splitting an amount among n people must always sum back to the amount. Use hypothesis.

steps.a: The property holds across 100 generated cases: sum preserved, n parts, and no part differs from another by more than one cent. I did not test n = 0, which raises ZeroDivisionError; the function doesn't define that case.

reference.summary: Added a hypothesis property test for the money splitting function checking that parts always sum to the amount, there are n of them and they differ by at most one cent; it passes. The zero-people case was not tested because the function leaves it undefined.
facts: parts differ by at most one cent
